context: Mrs. Mori brings homemade pickles over to Yumiko's; they chat.
purpose: Neighborly food exchange; warm community tradition.

lines.speaker: mrs_mori_neighbor
lines.jp: これ、おすそ分け、漬物よ。
lines.style: Warm, unhurried presentation. Slight lift on the offering itself. The ease of someone used to giving. No performance, just genuine generosity.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: まあ、いつもありがとう。
lines.style: Gentle acceptance, genuinely pleased. Soft landing on the gratitude. The rhythm of an old kindness, familiar and welcomed.

lines.speaker: mrs_mori_neighbor
lines.en: I had vegetables left over, you know.
lines.style: Matter-of-fact, almost dismissive of her own generosity. Warm undertone—this is just what neighbors do. No fuss, no fishing for compliments.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: お夕飯にいただくわね。
lines.style: Brighter here—genuine anticipation breaking through the polite surface. Soft, warm close. She means it.

lines.speaker: mrs_mori_neighbor
lines.en: Well, I'll make some more then.
lines.style: Small laugh underneath the words. A promise wrapped in ease. Settled, neighborly certainty. No obligation—just the simple pleasure of continuing.
